title: Meanders in Ridge Form in the Zephyria Region
description: In this image from NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter spacecraft, an ancient sinuous meandering river system is surrounded by features called yardangs. The yardangs are the ridge-like landforms that align approximately north-south. These features were created as the wind scoured and eroded the bedrock.
